note: Short branch Pcyc proportional to Prot^(1.324 ± 0.067) (their Eq. 8); with the Rossby-number relation the Sun's cycle comes out at 10.3 (+1.1, −1.0) yr and its long cycle at 104 yr; Slope 1.324 confirmed in the text; the intercept 1.488 and the long branch 2.22 + 1.28 were not seen. The paper's point is that rotation-only relations miss the Sun and its Rossby-number relation gives 10.3 yr; "6.1 years, Mittag say so too" was not seen. Add the journal DOI.
